consentBody.message: You give it once, for all of ContextFlow's AI. Each feature sends only what it needs, when you use it, via our server to Anthropic (Claude), OpenAI (backup answers, suggestions) and Google Gemini (Google answers). With your own API key, it goes straight to that provider. Nothing is kept on our servers; no one trains on it.

consentAnswers.message: Answers: your question, the page's text or your selection, and your “About me” if you wrote one. If Claude is unavailable, OpenAI answers; Google answers go to Google Gemini.

consentChats.message: “Ask your chats” and AI search (Pro): short excerpts of your chats.

consentTemplates.message: Templates: their text, to mark the blanks; the page's text for “Fill from the page”; your words and the templates' titles for “Find by meaning”.

consentWatch.message: Watching a page: what you selected, your words for when to tell you, the text around it and the page's title; later, the old and the new value.

consentSuggest.message: Suggestions (Pro, only once you turn them on): the text of new questions, answers and notes, to OpenAI to compare them and to Claude to check a tag.

consentStored.message: Your chats stay on your devices and, if you sync them, in your iCloud.

consentAgainTitle.message: Updated: one consent for all AI features

consentNeeded.message: Nothing was sent: AI answers need your consent first.

tip_623811ea30.message: Start a new chat with +. Earlier chats wait in the chat list: open one to pick up where you left off, rename it with the pencil, or delete it.

tip_eff80bffda.message: Type in the search over the chat list: every chat with those words, with the place they're in. A result opens the chat right there.

tip_6b5bdf707f.message: Tag a chat, an answer or a note with 🏷. Tap a tag to see only its chats, or turn on Folders to group the list by tag.

tip_aa15b6c2c0.message: Share one answer or the whole chat: the text comes with its links, its sources and a link to ContextFlow.

tip_969cf52d0b.message: The Chats tab has every chat from Safari. Ask about its pages or add a note right there, tag, copy or share any answer, or share the whole chat. “Continue in Safari” picks it up where you left off.

tip_52a09ac884.message: Tap ✦ next to the search and describe the chat you remember — “that article about sleep and coffee” — even without the exact words.

tip_8a40be768f.message: The first row of the chat list answers from all your chats at once: “What did I read this week?”, “Summarize my notes on AI”.

tip_c61e2edab3.message: Asked about a car in the chat about a sofa? Under the answer, ContextFlow suggests the chat it belongs in, or a new one. One tap moves it there, by date; Undo puts it back.

tip_69a0bac728.message: ContextFlow learns what your tags mean from where you put them, and suggests the right one under a new answer or note. Only your own tags, only when they fit.

tip_12e62d9862.message: Pro and Ultra come monthly or yearly, and a year costs less than twelve months. Tap Yearly above the plans, in the app or in Safari, to see each price and what you save. On monthly already? Switch to yearly is in Settings → Your plan: it starts when your current month ends.

tip_0f2289f887.message: After you buy Pro or Ultra, ContextFlow shows what your plan adds, a step at a time. To see it again, tap … at the top of the panel, then Other… and What's in Pro or What's in Ultra. In the app, it's in Settings, under Your plan.

tip_e2d1d4abd0.message: Add a line under About me — what you do, how you like answers — and ContextFlow will tailor them to you.

tip_1e9a1535cb.message: Hide ✦ when you don't need it

tip_6cc366173d.message: Don't need ✦ on a site? Hide it on that site, or turn it off everywhere in the extension settings. ContextFlow still opens from Safari's extensions menu.

tip_d84a0778d4.message: With Pro or the Own key plan, paste an OpenAI or Claude key in the extension settings in Safari. Requests then go straight to that provider.

tip_241d3ad076.message: ContextFlow reads a page only when you ask, and sends just its text to get the answer. Your chats stay on your devices and in your iCloud. With suggestions on, the text of new messages also goes to our server to find where they belong; we don't keep it.
